nodes.name: IF pretreatment
nodes.procedure: A piece of IF (30×30×1 mm) was successively washed with acetone, hydrochloric acid and deionized water.
nodes.source_text: Firstly, a piece of IF (30×30×1 mm) was successively washed with acetone, hydrochloric acid and deionized water.

nodes.name: NiMOF/IF hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: 0.75 mmol NiCl2⋅6H2O and 1.5 mmol Terephthalic acid were firstly dissolved in a 40 mL mixture solution of DMF/ethanol/water (v:v:v = 35:2.5:2.5). After magnetic stirring for 2 h, the homogeneous mixture solution was transferred into a 100 mL Teflon-lined stainless autoclave with a precleaned IF tilted against the wall at a certain angle. Subsequently, the sealed autoclave was put in an electric oven at 150 °C for 10 h. Finally, after naturally cooling down to 30 °C and thoroughly rinsed with deionized water, NiMOF/IF was successfully synthesized. For further characterization and measurement, the wet NiMOF/IF was dried at 60 °C overnight in vacuum.

nodes.name: NiMOF-Ni2P/IF phosphorization
nodes.procedure: 1.2 g NaH2PO2 powders and a prepared NiMOF/IF sheet (30×30×1 mm) were placed on the upstream side and downstream side of a porcelain boat, respectively. Then, the sample was heated to 350 °C at a ramping rate of 1 °C min⁻¹ for 2 h at the tube furnace, with inert Ar gas flowing at 40 s.c.c.m. Ultimately, NiMOF-Ni2P/IF was obtained when the temperature of the tube furnace come to 30 °C.
